sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior readiness obligations and applicable-only comparison, but repair the applicability alternatives. The current non-applicable sh:or contains SPARQL constraints that select violations, so it passes only when both thrusterType is outside {"azimuthing","fixed"} and mainPropulsionThruster is not true; valid non-applicable cases are incorrectly rejected and applicable ships may bypass readiness checks through that alternative.
